d:
Bihar men mausam ka mijaj dhire-dhire badal raha hai. subah aur sham ke vakt halki thand mahsus hone lagi hai, jabki din men tej dhup nikalne se garmi bani huee hai. mausam ke is utar-charhav ke bich agle kuchh dinon tak subah ke samay kohra dekhne ko mil sakta hai. mausam vibhag ne 15 navanbar ke mausam ke sath hi agle 5 dinon ke lie tapman, kohre aur barish ko lekar purvanuman jari kiya hai. aaie jante hain ki bihar ke kin jilon men kaisa mausam rahega.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
